headline.bm: Ketegangan Teluk berterusan: Trump mengugut menenggelamkan kapal Iran ketika Tehran menyediakan kapal tangki untuk menembusi sekatan AS, manakala Bahrain, Arab Saudi dan Kyiv diserang lagi. Wall Street melantun selepas Nvidia melantik semula CEO; penyerang menembusi peranti Cisco Expressway — tampal sekarang.
headline.en: Gulf escalation continues: Trump threatens to sink Iranian vessels as Tehran readies tankers to break the US blockade, while Bahrain, Saudi Arabia and Kyiv face fresh attacks. Wall Street rebounded on Nvidia's CEO reinstatement; attackers are breaching Cisco Expressway devices — patch now.

summary.bm: Pratonton The Star bagi sidang Dewan Rakyat 23 Nov menyenaraikan cukai minimum global dan isu pusat data antara soalan yang dibangkitkan, ketika perbahasan Belanjawan 2027 diteruskan. Lonjakan pusat data Malaysia diperhati rapi selepas laporan cip Nvidia di sebuah tapak di Johor.
summary.en: The Star's Dewan Rakyat preview for 23 Nov lists the global minimum tax and data-centre issues among questions to be raised, as the Budget 2027 debate continues. Malaysia's data-centre boom has been under scrutiny after the Nvidia-chip report on a Johor site.

title.bm: Dewan Rakyat hari ini: cukai minimum global dan pusat data antara isu tumpuan
title.en: Dewan Rakyat today: global minimum tax and data centres among issues in focus

why.bm: Peraturan cukai dan pusat data mempengaruhi pelaburan, pekerjaan serta penggunaan tenaga dan air.
why.en: Tax and data-centre rules shape investment, jobs and power and water use.

summary.bm: Pengerusi BN Ahmad Zahid Hamidi berkata demikian pada perhimpunan perwakilan MCA dan menyatakan lebih 170 negara melaksanakan GST. GST dikenakan pada kadar 6% sejak April 2015 sehingga digantikan SST (10% bagi kebanyakan barang, 6–8% bagi perkhidmatan) pada 1 Sept 2018.
summary.en: BN chairman Ahmad Zahid Hamidi made the pledge at the MCA delegates' assembly, saying more than 170 countries use GST. GST ran at 6% from April 2015 until it was replaced by SST (10% on most goods, 6–8% on services) on 1 Sept 2018.

title.bm: Zahid: BN akan kembalikan GST 'serta-merta' jika kembali ke Putrajaya dalam PRU16
title.en: Zahid: BN will reinstate GST 'immediately' if it returns to Putrajaya in GE16

why.bm: Dasar cukai bakal menjadi isu utama PRU16 dan boleh menjejaskan harga barang.
why.en: Tax policy is set to become a major GE16 issue and could affect household prices.

summary.bm: Laporan New York Times mendakwa cip Nvidia di pusat data YTL Johor digunakan untuk Alibaba, mengelak sekatan eksport AS. Timbalan Menteri MITI Sim Tze Tzin berkata Malaysia akan membuat semakan sendiri atas kemungkinan eksport semula cip.
summary.en: A New York Times report says Nvidia chips at YTL's Johor data centre were used for Alibaba, bypassing US export curbs. MITI Deputy Minister Sim Tze Tzin said Malaysia will run its own check on possible chip re-exports.

title.bm: NYT: Cip Nvidia di pusat data YTL Johor digunakan untuk Alibaba China; MITI akan siasat
title.en: NYT: Nvidia chips at YTL's Johor data centre run for China's Alibaba; MITI to probe

why.bm: Boleh mengundang pemerhatian AS terhadap sektor pusat data dan cip Malaysia.
why.en: Could bring US scrutiny on Malaysia's data-centre and chip sector.

summary.bm: Tuanku Muhriz bertitah Ismail Lasim kekal sebagai MB; Ismail menegaskan beliau tidak pernah menyerahkan surat peletakan jawatan 16 Nov dan mengakui kesilapan sambil mengulangi taat setia. Malay Mail melaporkan pihak istana menyatakan beliau perlu menunjukkan sokongan majoriti, bukan sekadar menafikan peletakan jawatan.
summary.en: Tuanku Muhriz decreed that Ismail Lasim stays on as MB; Ismail says he never submitted the 16 Nov resignation letter and acknowledged mistakes while reaffirming loyalty. Malay Mail reports the palace says he must show majority support, not merely deny resigning.

title.bm: Yang di-Pertuan Besar titahkan Ismail Lasim kekal sebagai Menteri Besar Negeri Sembilan
title.en: Negeri Sembilan Ruler decrees Ismail Lasim stays as Menteri Besar

why.bm: Menamatkan kebimbangan beberapa hari tentang kepimpinan negeri, walaupun imbangan BN–PH dan desakan MB baharu sebelum ini masih sensitif.
why.en: Ends days of uncertainty over who leads the state, though the BN–PH balance and the earlier push for a new MB remain politically sensitive.

summary.bm: Lapan kementerian telah selesai menggulung dalam perbahasan peringkat jawatankuasa Bajet 2027 di Dewan Rakyat, dengan lapan lagi dijadual minggu depan.
summary.en: Eight ministries have wound up in the Dewan Rakyat Budget 2027 committee-stage debate, with eight more due to do so next week.

title.bm: Perbahasan Bajet 2027: lapan kementerian selesai, lapan lagi minggu depan
title.en: Budget 2027 debate: eight ministries wind up, eight more next week

why.bm: Menunjukkan jadual Bajet 2027 dan bila peruntukan perbelanjaan dimuktamadkan.
why.en: Shows the Budget 2027 timetable and when spending allocations will be finalised.

summary.bm: Selepas pertemuan dua hala 20 minit dengan Xi pada 20 Nov, Anwar berkata perbincangan merangkumi projek bekalan air Sungai Perak ke Pulau Pinang, AI untuk penguatkuasaan sempadan, kerjasama TVET dan peningkatan eksport ke China. Beliau berkata Malaysia tidak akan mengeksport nadir bumi mentah, peraturan yang sama untuk semua negara, dan Xi akan menghantar pegawai kanan ke pelancaran ECRL pada Disember. Anwar turut berkata beliau tidak kesal menyokong Xi dan memuji peranan Xi menemukan Trump dan Putin.
summary.en: After a 20-minute bilateral with Xi on 20 Nov, Anwar said talks covered the Sungai Perak water project to Penang, AI for border enforcement, TVET cooperation and higher exports to China. He said Malaysia will not export raw rare earths, a rule applied to all countries, and Xi will send a senior official to the ECRL launch in December. Anwar also said he has no regrets backing Xi and credited him with bringing Trump and Putin together.

title.bm: Anwar bertemu Xi di Shenzhen: nadir bumi diproses di Malaysia, pegawai kanan China hadir pelancaran ECRL
title.en: Anwar meets Xi in Shenzhen: rare earths to be processed in Malaysia, ECRL launch to get senior Chinese delegate

why.bm: Menetapkan pendirian mengenai nadir bumi dan mendapat sokongan China untuk ECRL serta bekalan air Pulau Pinang.
why.en: Sets the line on rare earths and secures China's backing for ECRL and the Penang water supply.

summary.bm: Perbendaharaan AS telah mendesak Singapura dan Malaysia mematuhi sekatan Iran ketika Washington meluaskan sekatan lautnya ke atas penghantaran minyak Iran.
summary.en: The US Treasury has pressed Singapore and Malaysia to comply with Iran sanctions, as Washington widens its naval blockade on Iranian oil shipments.

title.bm: Perbendaharaan AS desak Singapura dan Malaysia patuhi sekatan Iran
title.en: US Treasury presses Singapore and Malaysia on Iran sanctions compliance

why.bm: Perairan dan syarikat perkapalan Malaysia sering dikaitkan dengan pemindahan kapal ke kapal, jadi pemantauan terhadap pematuhan tempatan meningkat.
why.en: Malaysian waters and shipping firms are often used for ship-to-ship transfers, so scrutiny on local compliance is rising.

summary.bm: Ekonomi Malaysia berkembang 5.5% pada suku ketiga, perlahan berbanding 6.0% setahun lalu tetapi melebihi anggaran awal 5.3%, dengan laporan menyebut pelaburan, eksport, permintaan berkaitan AI dan pelancongan.
summary.en: Malaysia's economy expanded 5.5% in the third quarter, eased from 6.0% a year earlier but above the 5.3% advance estimate, with reports citing investment, exports, AI-related demand and tourism.

title.bm: KDNK suku ketiga Malaysia berkembang 5.5%, melepasi anggaran awal 5.3%, didorong pelaburan dan eksport
title.en: Malaysia's Q3 GDP grows 5.5%, beating the 5.3% advance estimate, on investment and exports

why.bm: Pertumbuhan stabil menyokong pekerjaan dan ringgit, namun risiko luar daripada perang Iran dan harga minyak kekal.
why.en: Steady growth supports jobs and the ringgit, though external risks from the Iran war and oil remain.

summary.bm: Timbalan Menteri Sumber Manusia Khairul Firdaus berkata hanya pekerja asing tanpa rekod jenayah dibenarkan masuk melalui sistem bersepadu dengan polis. Seramai 2.082 juta pemegang PLKS direkodkan setakat 15 Okt, dengan 241,178 kuota 2026 berbaki.
summary.en: Deputy Human Resources Minister Khairul Firdaus says only foreign workers with no criminal record are admitted, via a system linked to police. 2.082 million PLKS holders were recorded as of 15 Oct, with 241,178 left in the 2026 quota.

title.bm: Pekerja asing disaring dengan rekod polis; nisbah PLKS diturunkan kepada 10% menjelang 2030
title.en: Foreign workers screened with police records; PLKS ratio to fall to 10% by 2030

why.bm: Memberi kesan kepada majikan yang mengambil pekerja asing dan kebimbangan keselamatan awam.
why.en: Affects employers hiring foreign labour and public safety concerns.

summary.bm: Timbalan Menteri Abdul Rahman Mohamad memberitahu Dewan Rakyat bahawa projek pusat data tidak akan diluluskan tanpa memastikan bekalan asas mencukupi. Air kitar semula membekalkan sehingga 12 juta liter sehari di Johor.
summary.en: Deputy Minister Abdul Rahman Mohamad told the Dewan Rakyat that data-centre projects will not be approved without confirming basic supply first. Reclaimed water supplies up to 12 million litres a day in Johor.

title.bm: Tarif air dan elektrik tidak akan naik untuk menampung keperluan pusat data
title.en: Water and electricity tariffs will not rise to meet data-centre needs

why.bm: Meredakan kebimbangan bil isi rumah naik akibat pusat data.
why.en: Eases worries that household bills rise because of data centres.

summary.bm: SPR berkata 41,958 warganegara berumur 18 tahun ke atas didaftarkan secara automatik, manakala 17,076 menukar kawasan. Daftar pemilih tambahan diwartakan hari ini dan dibuka untuk semakan 60 hari.
summary.en: The Election Commission says 41,958 people aged 18+ were automatically registered, with 17,076 changing constituency. The supplementary roll was gazetted today and is open for 60 days.

title.bm: SPR: hampir 42,000 pemilih baharu didaftarkan pada Oktober; semakan dibuka hingga 21 Jan
title.en: SPR: nearly 42,000 new voters registered in October; roll open for checking until 21 Jan

why.bm: Semak butiran pemilih anda melalui portal SPR, MySPR atau talian 03-8892 7218.
why.en: Check your voter details via the SPR portal, MySPR or hotline 03-8892 7218.

summary.bm: Semua peruncit termasuk kedai pedalaman boleh memohon terminal pembayaran daripada MOF untuk menyertai SARA. RM250 juta setahun bagi 2026 dan 2027 membiayai pengagihan barang keperluan ke 828 kawasan.
summary.en: All retailers, including rural shops, may apply to MOF for a payment terminal to join SARA. RM250 million a year for 2026 and 2027 funds essential-goods distribution to 828 areas.

title.bm: Kedai runcit pedalaman layak sertai SARA, kata kementerian di Dewan Rakyat
title.en: Rural grocers can join SARA, ministry tells Dewan Rakyat

why.bm: Membantu penerima di kawasan terpencil menggunakan bantuan SARA di kedai berhampiran.
why.en: Helps recipients in remote areas use SARA aid at nearby shops.

summary.bm: Anak beliau mengesahkan kepada Bernama bahawa Menteri Besar sedang menerima rawatan di sebuah hospital di Seremban. Setiausaha akhbar beliau berkata keadaannya menunjukkan tanda pemulihan.
summary.en: His son confirmed to Bernama that the Menteri Besar is receiving treatment at a hospital in Seremban. His press secretary says his condition shows signs of improvement.

title.bm: MB Negeri Sembilan Ismail Lasim dilaporkan tidak sihat, dirawat di hospital Seremban
title.en: Negeri Sembilan MB Ismail Lasim reportedly unwell, treated at Seremban hospital

why.bm: Ia menambah ketidaktentuan kepimpinan negeri dan majlis angkat sumpah exco yang tertangguh.
why.en: It adds to the uncertainty over the state's leadership and the stalled exco swearing-in.

summary.bm: Menteri Dalam Negeri Saifuddin Nasution berkata minit Lembaga Pengampunan Wilayah Persekutuan berhubung tahanan rumah Najib Razak telah dinyahrahsia. Langkah ini membolehkan kerajaan menjawab cabaran mahkamah Majlis Peguam Malaysia.
summary.en: Home Minister Saifuddin Nasution said the Federal Territories Pardons Board minutes on Najib Razak's house arrest were declassified. The move lets the government respond to the Malaysian Bar's court challenge.

title.bm: Minit tahanan rumah Najib dinyahrahsia bagi membolehkan kerajaan menjawab Majlis Peguam di mahkamah
title.en: Najib house-arrest minutes declassified so govt can answer Malaysian Bar in court

why.bm: Ujian penting ketelusan dalam proses pengampunan.
why.en: A key test of transparency in the pardons process.

summary.bm: Pearly Tan dan M. Thinaah menjuarai beregu wanita Hong Kong Terbuka, menamatkan penantian 26 tahun Malaysia dalam acara itu, ketika pasangan Malaysia menyapu bersih gelaran beregu.
summary.en: Pearly Tan and M. Thinaah won the Hong Kong Open women's doubles, ending a 26-year wait for Malaysia in the event, as Malaysian pairs swept the doubles titles.

title.bm: Pearly Tan–M. Thinaah tamatkan penantian 26 tahun, Malaysia sapu bersih gelaran beregu Hong Kong
title.en: Pearly Tan–M. Thinaah end 26-year drought as Malaysia sweep Hong Kong doubles titles

why.bm: Suntikan semangat buat badminton negara.
why.en: A morale boost for national badminton.

summary.bm: Saifuddin berkata tangkapan lanjut mungkin dibuat selepas rampasan dadah 96.6kg di sebuah pangkalan udara. Dua lagi anggota TUDM di Tawau direman ketika siasatan penyeludupan dadah membabitkan tentera diperluas.
summary.en: Saifuddin said further arrests may follow the 96.6kg drug find at an air base. Two more RMAF personnel in Tawau were remanded as the military drug-smuggling probe widens.

title.bm: Kerajaan pertimbang kawalan keselamatan lebih ketat di pangkalan tentera dan polis selepas rampasan dadah 96.6kg; dua lagi anggota TUDM Tawau direman
title.en: Govt mulls tighter security at military and police bases after 96.6kg drug find; two more Tawau RMAF personnel remanded

why.bm: Menimbulkan persoalan keselamatan di dalam kemudahan angkatan tentera.
why.en: Raises questions on security inside armed forces facilities.

summary.bm: Panglima Tentera Udara berkata penyiasat tidak menolak kemungkinan dadah diseludup ke luar negara menerusi penerbangan tentera, susulan penemuan dadah di pangkalan udara Subang.
summary.en: The air force chief said investigators are not ruling out that drugs were smuggled abroad on military flights, following the Subang air base drug find.

title.bm: Panglima TUDM tidak menolak penyeludupan meth ke luar negara menerusi penerbangan ke Indonesia, Thailand dan Brunei
title.en: RMAF chief does not rule out meth smuggling abroad on flights to Indonesia, Thailand and Brunei

why.bm: Menimbulkan kebimbangan keselamatan negara dan integriti di kemudahan tentera.
why.en: Raises national-security and integrity concerns about military facilities.

summary.bm: Sumber memaklumkan Malay Mail majlis angkat sumpah yang dirancang tidak berlangsung kerana sebahagian calon exco menarik diri, memanjangkan ketidaktentuan politik negeri. Dakwaan ini daripada sumber tanpa nama.
summary.en: A source told Malay Mail the planned swearing-in did not proceed because some nominated exco members pulled out, prolonging the state's political uncertainty. The claim is from an unnamed source.

title.bm: Majlis angkat sumpah Negeri Sembilan tertangguh, beberapa calon exco dilaporkan menarik diri
title.en: Negeri Sembilan swearing-in falls through as some exco nominees reportedly pull out

why.bm: Pentadbiran negeri masih belum stabil.
why.en: State governance remains unsettled.

summary.bm: Jabatan kesihatan berkata Hospital Ampang telah mengambil langkah menangani peningkatan 25% pesakit. Pesakit menghadapi tempoh menunggu yang lama untuk kemasukan.
summary.en: The health department says Ampang Hospital has taken steps to cope with a 25% rise in patients. Patients faced long waits for admission.

title.bm: Menunggu lama untuk kemasukan di Hospital Ampang apabila kes kecemasan melonjak 25%
title.en: Long wait for admission at Ampang Hospital as emergency cases surge 25%

why.bm: Kes tidak kritikal mungkin lebih sesuai ke klinik.
why.en: Non-urgent cases may be better served at clinics.

summary.bm: Saifuddin berkata hampir 25,000 banduan dibebaskan awal bagi mengurangkan kesesakan. Banduan yang layak ditempatkan dalam pekerjaan di bawah program ODI.
summary.en: Saifuddin said nearly 25,000 prisoners were released early to ease overcrowding. Eligible prisoners are placed in jobs under an ODI programme.

title.bm: Hampir 25,000 banduan dibebaskan awal bagi mengurangkan kesesakan penjara
title.en: Nearly 25,000 prisoners released early to ease overcrowding

why.bm: Menunjukkan skala kesesakan penjara dan usaha pemulihan.
why.en: Shows the scale of prison overcrowding and rehabilitation efforts.

summary.bm: Dua wanita maut selepas tercampak keluar dari sebuah Mercedes di Lebuhraya Persekutuan pada pagi Sabtu. Polis memburu pemandu yang melarikan diri.
summary.en: Two women died after being thrown from a Mercedes on the Federal Highway on Saturday morning. Police are hunting the driver who fled.

title.bm: Dua wanita maut selepas tercampak keluar dari Mercedes di Lebuhraya Persekutuan; pemandu melarikan diri
title.en: Two women killed after being thrown from a Mercedes on Federal Highway; driver fled

why.bm: Peringatan lain tentang risiko keselamatan jalan raya.
why.en: Another reminder of road safety risks.

summary.bm: Selepas lawatan mengejut, Menteri Besar Johor mengkritik keadaan terminal itu termasuk tandas terbiar yang mengenakan bayaran 50 sen setiap kali guna.
summary.en: After a surprise visit, the Johor Menteri Besar criticised the state of the terminal, including neglected toilets that charge 50 sen per use.

title.bm: MB Johor Onn Hafiz hilang sabar dengan Larkin Sentral selepas lawatan mengejut
title.en: Johor MB Onn Hafiz loses patience with Larkin Sentral after surprise visit

why.bm: Memberi kesan kepada pengguna harian dan pengembara di hab sibuk Johor Bahru.
why.en: Affects daily commuters and travellers using the busy Johor Bahru hub.

summary.bm: Pengarah HSA Dr Mohamad Nizam Subahir berkata pasukan kardiotorasik meneruskan perkhidmatan mengikut keperluan klinikal.
summary.en: HSA director Dr Mohamad Nizam Subahir said the cardiothoracic team continues services under clinical requirements.

title.bm: HSA Johor: pembedahan jantung berjalan seperti biasa selepas pakar bedah utama berhenti
title.en: Johor HSA says heart surgery running as usual after top surgeon resigns

why.bm: Jaminan buat pesakit jantung di Johor.
why.en: Reassurance for heart patients in Johor.

summary.bm: Malay Mail melaporkan pada 20 Nov pelan melatih 10,000 pelarian Rohingya dan menempatkan semula mereka di Türkiye. Pada 21 Nov, Türkiye menyatakan hantaran Zahid mengenai pelan itu telah dipadam manakala Putrajaya berdiam diri. Pembantu Zahid berkata pelan penempatan semula masih diselaraskan.
summary.en: Malay Mail reported on 20 Nov the plan to train 10,000 Rohingya refugees and resettle them in Türkiye. On 21 Nov it reported Türkiye pointing out that Zahid's post on the plan had been removed while Putrajaya went quiet. Zahid's aide says the relocation plan is still being coordinated.

title.bm: Pelan Rohingya Putrajaya: latihan kemahiran 10,000 orang dan penempatan semula di Türkiye; Ankara tegaskan hantaran Zahid sudah dipadam
title.en: Putrajaya's Rohingya plan: skills training for 10,000 and resettlement in Türkiye; Ankara notes Zahid's post is gone

why.bm: Dasar pelarian masih belum jelas; belum ada pengesahan rasmi.
why.en: Refugee policy remains unclear; no official confirmation yet.

summary.bm: Premier Sarawak Abang Johari mengalu-alukan keputusan BN dan PAS tidak bertanding PRN. Presiden Amanah Mat Sabu turut berkata parti itu tidak bertanding dan menumpukan persediaan PRU16.
summary.en: Sarawak Premier Abang Johari welcomed the BN and PAS decision to skip the state polls. Amanah president Mat Sabu also said the party will not contest and will focus on GE16.

title.bm: BN, PAS dan Amanah tidak bertanding PRN Sarawak; Abang Johari alu-alukan keputusan
title.en: BN, PAS and Amanah to skip Sarawak polls; Abang Johari welcomes decision

why.bm: Membentuk landskap pertandingan PRN Sarawak.
why.en: Shapes the contest ahead of the Sarawak election.

summary.bm: Sinar Harian melaporkan lembaga LTAT memilih Achi Jaya sebagai pembeli pilihan BPlant, dengan kelulusan akhir di tangan PM. LTAT dijangka bertemu Anwar mengenai cadangan jualan itu.
summary.en: Sinar Harian reports the LTAT board has chosen Achi Jaya as preferred buyer for BPlant, with the final nod resting with the PM. LTAT is expected to meet Anwar on the proposed sale.

title.bm: Lembaga LTAT pilih Achi Jaya sebagai pembeli pilihan Boustead Plantations
title.en: LTAT board picks Achi Jaya as preferred buyer for Boustead Plantations

why.bm: Menjejaskan aset ladang GLC utama dan ahli dana angkatan tentera.
why.en: Affects a major GLC plantation asset and armed forces fund members.

summary.bm: Malay Mail melaporkan Tok Mat berkata wakil rakyat BN dan Perikatan negeri bersetuju mengikut pimpinan tertinggi bagi menamatkan kebuntuan. Ia susulan titah Yang di-Pertuan Besar bahawa Ismail Lasim kekal sebagai Menteri Besar.
summary.en: Malay Mail reports Tok Mat says BN and Perikatan state representatives agreed to follow their top leaders to end the impasse. It follows the Ruler's decree that Ismail Lasim stays as Menteri Besar.

title.bm: Wakil BN dan Perikatan Negeri Sembilan setuju patuh pimpinan tertinggi untuk menamatkan kebuntuan politik
title.en: Negeri Sembilan BN and Perikatan reps agree to obey top leadership to end political impasse

why.bm: Menunjukkan sama ada kerajaan negeri dapat stabil selepas beberapa hari tidak menentu.
why.en: Shows whether the state government can stabilise after days of uncertainty.

summary.bm: Malay Mail melaporkan Ketua Menteri Chow Kon Yeow berkata kerjasama Umno-Pakatan di Pulau Pinang mesti kekal hingga akhir penggal, manakala seorang wakil PKR menyuarakan kebimbangan.
summary.en: Malay Mail reports Chief Minister Chow Kon Yeow says the Umno-Pakatan pact in Penang must hold until the end of the term, while a PKR representative raised concerns.

title.bm: Kerjasama Umno-Pakatan di Pulau Pinang mesti kekal hingga akhir penggal, kata Chow Kon Yeow ketika wakil PKR membangkitkan kebimbangan
title.en: Penang Umno-Pakatan pact must hold till end of term, says Chow Kon Yeow as PKR rep sounds alarm

why.bm: Menunjukkan ketegangan kerjasama kerajaan perpaduan di peringkat negeri.
why.en: Signals strains in unity-government cooperation at state level.

summary.bm: Beregu lelaki Malaysia menewaskan pasangan India No. 6 dunia untuk mara ke final badminton Terbuka Hong Kong.
summary.en: Malaysia's men's doubles pair beat the world No. 6 Indian duo to book a place in the Hong Kong Open badminton final.

title.bm: Man Wei Chong-Tee Kai Wun kejutkan pasangan India No. 6 dunia untuk mara ke final Terbuka Hong Kong
title.en: Man Wei Chong-Tee Kai Wun stun world No. 6 Indian pair to reach Hong Kong Open final

why.bm: Dorongan buat badminton Malaysia menjelang aksi final.
why.en: A boost for Malaysian badminton going into the final.

summary.bm: Amaran ribut petir dan hujan lebat berkuatkuasa di lima negeri dan Labuan hingga 4 petang ini, menurut Bernama.
summary.en: A thunderstorm and heavy-rain warning is in force for five states and Labuan until 4pm today, per Bernama.

title.bm: Amaran ribut petir dan hujan lebat di lima negeri dan Labuan hingga 4 petang
title.en: Thunderstorm and heavy rain warning in five states and Labuan until 4pm

why.bm: Elak jalan yang mudah banjir dan semak kemas kini MetMalaysia.
why.en: Avoid flood-prone roads and check MetMalaysia updates.

summary.bm: Ahli Parlimen Muar tamat 48 minit selepas sasaran 12 jam yang dikaitkan dengan ikrar itu.
summary.en: The Muar MP finished 48 minutes past the 12-hour target tied to the pledge.

title.bm: Syed Saddiq tamat Ironman Malaysia lewat 48 minit daripada had 12 jam, ikrar RM200,000 untuk Muar tidak dipenuhi
title.en: Syed Saddiq misses Ironman Malaysia 12-hour mark by 48 minutes, so no RM200,000 for Muar pledge

why.bm: Ikrar awam berkait keputusan sukan menarik perhatian ramai.
why.en: A public pledge tied to a sporting result drew wide attention.

summary.bm: Dua lagi anggota direman dalam siasatan penyeludupan dadah melibatkan tentera di Sabah. Ia susulan rampasan 96.6kg dadah di sebuah pangkalan udara.
summary.en: Two more personnel were remanded in the military drug-smuggling probe in Sabah. It follows the 96.6kg drug find at an air base.

title.bm: Dua lagi anggota TUDM Tawau direman apabila siasatan penyeludupan dadah meluas
title.en: Two more Tawau RMAF personnel remanded as drug-smuggling probe widens

why.bm: Menimbulkan persoalan keselamatan dalam pangkalan tentera.
why.en: Raises questions on security inside military bases.

summary.bm: Ketua Polis Kulai ACP Tan Seng Lee berkata seorang suspek ditahan kerana pelaburan palsu itu.
summary.en: Kulai police chief ACP Tan Seng Lee said a suspect was arrested over the fake investment.

title.bm: Wanita Johor rugi RM250,000 kepada teman lelaki dalam pelaburan palsu; suspek ditahan
title.en: Johor woman loses RM250,000 to boyfriend in bogus investment; suspect held

why.bm: Semak sebarang skim pelaburan, walaupun ditawarkan orang yang dipercayai.
why.en: Verify any investment scheme, even when pitched by someone you trust.

summary.bm: Kospi ditutup turun 3.3% selepas jatuh sehingga 5.8%, Hang Seng turun 0.1% dan Taiex pulih 2.2%; niaga hadapan S&P 500 dan Nasdaq naik sekitar 2–3% selepas kejatuhan Wall Street Jumaat (S&P -3.7%, Nasdaq -5.3%). Keraguan terhadap perbelanjaan AI berhutang mendorong kejatuhan.
summary.en: Kospi closed down 3.3% after falling as much as 5.8%, Hang Seng ended down 0.1% and Taiex rebounded 2.2%; S&P 500 and Nasdaq futures rose about 2–3% after Friday's Wall St rout (S&P -3.7%, Nasdaq -5.3%). Doubts over debt-funded AI spending drive the slide.

title.bm: Saham teknologi Asia merosot lagi kerana bimbang gelembung AI: Kospi jatuh kira-kira 4%, niaga hadapan AS melantun 2%
title.en: Asian tech stocks slide again on AI-bubble fears: Kospi falls about 4% as US futures bounce 2%

why.bm: Kejatuhan teknologi global boleh menjejaskan saham teknologi dan semikonduktor di Bursa serta ringgit, dan mungkin mengurangkan nilai simpanan persaraan dan unit amanah.
why.en: A global tech sell-off can hit Bursa tech and semiconductor counters and the ringgit, and may dent retirement and unit trust values.

summary.bm: Dalam dagangan awal Isnin, S&P 500 naik sekitar 4.8% hampir 7,240, Nasdaq sekitar 6.8% dan Dow sekitar 2.7%, memulihkan sebahagian besar kejatuhan Jumaat (angka waktu pembukaan, bukan penutup). Pasaran masih meramal kira-kira 91–96% kemungkinan kenaikan kadar Fed pada Disember.
summary.en: In early Monday trade the S&P 500 was about 4.8% higher near 7,240, the Nasdaq about 6.8% and the Dow about 2.7%, recovering much of Friday's slide (these are opening-hour figures, not closes). Traders still price roughly a 91–96% chance of a Fed rate hike in December.

title.bm: Wall Street melonjak ketika dibuka apabila Nvidia melantik semula Jensen Huang; S&P 500 naik kira-kira 4.8% awal dagangan
title.en: Wall Street surges at the open as Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang; S&P 500 up about 4.8% in early trade

why.bm: Turun naik teknologi AS mempengaruhi Bursa dan ringgit; lantunan sehari belum mengesahkan pemulihan.
why.en: Volatility in US tech sets the tone for Bursa and the ringgit; a one-day bounce does not yet confirm a recovery.

summary.bm: S&P 500 jatuh 3.59% kepada 6,918.45, Dow 1.85% kepada 48,188.18 dan Nasdaq 5.13% kepada 22,654.15 pada Jumaat (awal). S&P telah jatuh tujuh sesi berturut-turut, rekod terpanjang sejak Feb 2020, dengan ketiga-tiga indeks mencatat kerugian mingguan terbesar sejak April 2025.
summary.en: The S&P 500 fell 3.59% to 6,918.45, the Dow 1.85% to 48,188.18 and the Nasdaq 5.13% to 22,654.15 on Friday (preliminary). The S&P has now dropped seven straight sessions, its longest streak since Feb 2020, with all three indexes posting their biggest weekly loss since April 2025.

title.bm: Wall Street merudum: S&P 500 dan Dow sahkan pembetulan apabila penampilan sulung Anthropic pudar; Nasdaq -5.1%
title.en: Wall St rout: S&P 500 and Dow confirm corrections as Anthropic's debut fades; Nasdaq -5.1%

why.bm: Niaga hadapan menjangka kenaikan kadar Fed hampir pasti pada Disember; selera risiko global, saham teknologi/eksport Malaysia dan ringgit mungkin tertekan.
why.en: Futures price a near-certain Fed hike in December; global risk appetite and Malaysian tech/export stocks and the ringgit may feel the pressure.

summary.bm: Emas spot jatuh daripada $3,869 pada permulaan minggu kepada paras terendah $3,503 pada Jumaat, ditekan Fed yang hawkish (kenaikan kadar Disember sudah diambil kira), hasil bon lebih tinggi, dolar lebih kukuh dan jualan paksa ketika kejatuhan saham teknologi. Kebanyakan penganalisis yang ditinjau menjangka penurunan lanjut.
summary.en: Spot gold fell from $3,869 at the week's open to a low of $3,503 on Friday, hit by a hawkish Fed (another December hike is priced), higher yields, a stronger dollar and forced liquidations during the tech sell-off. Most surveyed analysts expect further declines.

title.bm: Emas jatuh 8.7% minggu ini kepada sekitar $3,540, minggu terburuk dalam lapan bulan
title.en: Gold plunges 8.7% on the week to about $3,540, its worst week in eight months

why.bm: Simpanan berkaitan emas dan produk emas dalam ringgit akan mengikut penurunan ini.
why.en: Gold-linked savings and ringgit-priced gold products will mirror the drop.

summary.bm: Golongan muda mengadakan protes di beberapa negara Eropah dengan slogan 'Berjuang untuk masa depan kita, bukan perang mereka'.
summary.en: Young people held protests in several European countries under the slogan 'Fight for our future, not their wars'.

title.bm: Protes anti-perang diketuai belia melanda Eropah
title.en: Youth-led anti-war protests sweep across Europe

why.bm: Menandakan tekanan awam yang meningkat terhadap kerajaan Eropah berhubung perang dan perbelanjaan pertahanan.
why.en: Signals rising public pressure on European governments over war and defence spending.

summary.bm: Tinjauan Tenaga Dunia 2026 IEA menyatakan perang menghilangkan kira-kira 2.8 bilion tong minyak dan 60 bcm gas, dan permintaan minyak global jatuh 2.7 juta tong sehari pada 2026 kepada 102.3 juta. Brent ditutup hampir $93.6 dan WTI hampir $84.5 pada 19 Nov.
summary.en: The IEA's World Energy Outlook 2026 says the war removed about 2.8 billion barrels of oil and 60 bcm of gas, and global oil demand falls 2.7 mb/d in 2026 to 102.3 mb/d. Brent closed 19 Nov near $93.6 and WTI near $84.5.

title.bm: IEA: Perang Iran hilangkan 2.8 bilion tong minyak; permintaan minyak global jatuh pertama sejak 2020
title.en: IEA: Iran war cost 2.8bn barrels of oil; global oil demand set for first drop since 2020

why.bm: Mempengaruhi jangkaan minyak, subsidi bahan api dan ringgit Malaysia.
why.en: Shapes oil, fuel-subsidy and ringgit expectations for Malaysia.

summary.bm: Brent sekitar $92 setong, WTI sekitar $83 selepas jatuh 3.2% ke paras terendah sejak 26 Ogos. Aliran minyak mentah Hormuz hampir pulih ke paras sebelum perang dan stok AS naik 3.4 juta tong, manakala jangkaan kenaikan kadar Fed menyokong dolar.
summary.en: Brent was about $92 a barrel, WTI about $83 after a 3.2% drop that took it to its lowest since 26 August. Hormuz crude flows are back near pre-war levels and US crude stocks rose 3.4 million barrels, while Fed hike expectations support the dollar.

title.bm: Minyak stabil sekitar $92 apabila serangan perkapalan Asia Barat mengimbangi jangkaan lebihan bekalan
title.en: Oil steady near $92 as Middle East shipping attacks offset supply-surplus outlook

why.bm: Minyak lebih murah meredakan tekanan kos bahan api dan subsidi, tetapi serangan kapal tangki menjadikan harga tidak menentu.
why.en: Lower oil eases pressure on fuel and subsidy costs, but tanker attacks keep prices volatile.

summary.bm: Dolar mencecah puncak 19 bulan baharu kerana jangkaan pengetatan Fed, dan saham jatuh selepas sekatan cip AI baharu AS terhadap China. Kuprum LME tiga bulan turun 0.4% kepada $13,210 satu tan, terendah lebih empat bulan.
summary.en: The dollar hit a fresh 19-month peak on bets of Fed tightening, and stocks fell after new US AI-chip curbs on China. Three-month LME copper fell 0.4% to $13,210 a tonne, its lowest in over four months.

title.bm: Dolar cecah paras tertinggi 19 bulan atas jangkaan Fed ketatkan dasar; kuprum terendah empat bulan
title.en: Dollar hits fresh 19-month high on Fed tightening bets; copper at four-month low

why.bm: Dolar kukuh menekan ringgit dan kos import.
why.en: A strong dollar pressures the ringgit and import costs.

summary.bm: Laporan yang memetik Wall Street Journal menyatakan AS hilang status penghapusan campak selepas penularan berterusan; ABC melaporkan kes seluruh negara melebihi 5,400 dengan 10 kematian. CDC merekodkan 5,412 kes disahkan setakat 13 Nov, naik 230 seminggu. CIDRAP kini merekodkan sekitar 5,838 kes AS.
summary.en: Reports citing the Wall Street Journal say the US lost its measles elimination status after continued spread; ABC reports nationwide cases above 5,400 with 10 deaths. The CDC counted 5,412 confirmed cases by 13 Nov, up 230 in a week. CIDRAP now counts about 5,838 US cases.

title.bm: AS dilaporkan hilang status penghapusan campak apabila kes melebihi 5,400
title.en: US reported to lose measles elimination status as cases top 5,400

why.bm: Semak vaksin MMR anak sebelum melancong ke AS.
why.en: Check children's MMR vaccination before travelling to the US.

summary.bm: Lebih 11,000 kes dan 5,400 kematian di 67 zon kesihatan di lapan wilayah DR Congo; 400–500 kes baharu seminggu. Kenya mencatat sembilan kes berkaitan (dua kematian) dan Nigeria satu kes import.
summary.en: Over 11,000 cases and 5,400 deaths across 67 health zones in eight DR Congo provinces; 400–500 new cases weekly. Kenya has nine linked cases (two deaths) and Nigeria one imported case.

title.bm: WHO: Kes Ebola Bundibugyo melebihi 11,000 ketika jawatankuasa kecemasan bersidang kali ketiga
title.en: WHO: Bundibugyo Ebola cases top 11,000 as emergency committee meets for a third time

why.bm: Risiko kepada Malaysia rendah, tetapi pelancong ke kawasan terjejas perlu mengikut nasihat kesihatan.
why.en: Risk to Malaysia is low, but travellers to affected areas should follow health advisories.

summary.bm: Gardenia Malaysia Timur menjelaskan ia entiti berasingan daripada Gardenia KL selepas aduan membabitkan Original Classic White Bread dan Twiggies Choc-A-Lot. KKM menunggu keputusan makmal dan akan memeriksa kilang KL di bawah Akta Makanan 1983; nombor kelompok belum lengkap.
summary.en: Gardenia East Malaysia says it is separate from Gardenia KL after complaints involving Original Classic White Bread and Twiggies Choc-A-Lot. The Health Ministry awaits lab results and will inspect the KL factory under the Food Act 1983; batch numbers are incomplete.

title.bm: Malaysia: KKM siasat dakwaan sakit selepas makan produk Gardenia
title.en: Malaysia: KKM probes illness claims linked to Gardenia bread and snacks

why.bm: Nota keselamatan: simpan bungkusan dan lapor gejala kepada KKM; tiada penarikan balik diumumkan.
why.en: Safety note: keep the packaging and report symptoms to KKM; no recall announced.

summary.bm: Gulf News dan beberapa media melaporkan Trump memberi amaran kapal Iran boleh ditenggelamkan, manakala pegawai Iran berikrar membalas dan terdapat laporan serangan AS ke atas sebuah kapal tangki minyak. Bahrain berasingan berkata ia memintas serangan Iran ketika Tehran menyediakan 14 kapal tangki untuk mencabar sekatan tentera laut.
summary.en: Gulf News and other outlets report Trump warning that Iranian ships could be sunk, with Iranian officials vowing a response and reports of a US strike on an oil tanker. Bahrain separately says it intercepted Iranian attacks as Tehran prepares 14 tankers to challenge the naval blockade.

title.bm: Trump ugut tenggelamkan kapal Iran ketika Tehran menyediakan kapal tangki untuk menembusi sekatan AS
title.en: Trump threatens to sink Iranian vessels as Tehran readies tankers to break the US blockade

why.bm: Peningkatan ketegangan di Hormuz mengekalkan risiko minyak dan perkapalan, yang memberi kesan kepada kos bahan api, ringgit dan perdagangan Malaysia.
why.en: Escalation at Hormuz keeps oil and shipping risk high, which feeds into fuel costs, the ringgit and Malaysian trade.

summary.bm: Pegawai Ukraine berkata 11 maut apabila bangunan lima tingkat di Dymer separa runtuh, 3 maut di sebuah pasar raya di Vyshneve dan 1 di Bila Tserkva; penyelamat masih menggeledah runtuhan dengan 11 orang belum ditemui. Sebuah pencawang elektrik di wilayah Dnipropetrovsk turut diserang selepas Putin berikrar membalas lebih keras serangan Ukraine ke atas jambatan Crimea.
summary.en: Ukrainian officials say 11 died when a five-storey block in Dymer partly collapsed, 3 died at a supermarket in Vyshneve and 1 in Bila Tserkva; rescuers were still searching the rubble with 11 people unaccounted for. A power substation in Dnipropetrovsk region was also hit, after Putin vowed a harsher response to Ukrainian strikes on the Crimea bridge.

title.bm: Serangan Rusia bunuh sekurang-kurangnya 15 orang di wilayah Kyiv, kata Ukraine
title.en: Russian strikes kill at least 15 across Kyiv region, Ukraine says

why.bm: Peningkatan serangan menekan keselamatan tenaga Eropah dan rundingan pembiayaan Ukraine di Majlis Eropah 26-27 Nov.
why.en: Escalation raises pressure on Europe's energy security and Ukraine funding talks at the 26-27 Nov European Council.

summary.bm: Gulf News melaporkan Bahrain memintas serangan Iran manakala Tehran menyiapkan 14 kapal tangki untuk menembusi sekatan AS; IRGC Iran pula berkata dua kapal tangki super 'melanggar' meletup selepas terkena periuk api di Hormuz. Manila Times melaporkan sebuah kemudahan industri awam di Bahrain terkena serangan.
summary.en: Gulf News reports Bahrain intercepted Iranian attacks while Tehran prepares 14 tankers to breach the US blockade; Iran's IRGC separately says two 'violating' supertankers exploded after hitting mines in Hormuz. Manila Times reports a civilian industrial facility in Bahrain was struck.

title.bm: Bahrain pintas serangan Iran ketika Tehran dilaporkan menyiapkan 14 kapal tangki minyak untuk menguji sekatan laut AS
title.en: Bahrain intercepts Iranian attacks as Tehran reportedly readies 14 oil tankers to test the US naval blockade

why.bm: Sebarang pertempuran baharu pelayaran di Hormuz meningkatkan risiko harga minyak dan kos bahan api untuk Malaysia serta inflasi global.
why.en: Any new Hormuz shipping clash lifts oil and fuel-cost risks for Malaysia and global inflation.

summary.bm: Houthi Yaman berkata mereka menyerang sebuah kilang minyak Saudi, manakala Presiden Trump memberi amaran serangan lanjut ke atas Iran mungkin berlaku tahun depan. Konflik Teluk berterusan bersama pertempuran di sekitar Hormuz dan Bahrain.
summary.en: Yemen's Houthis said they attacked a Saudi oil refinery, while President Trump warned that further strikes on Iran may come next year. The Gulf conflict continues alongside clashes around Hormuz and Bahrain.

title.bm: Houthi dakwa serang kilang minyak Saudi manakala Trump beri amaran serangan baharu tahun depan
title.en: Houthis claim attacks on Saudi oil refinery as Trump warns of new strikes next year

why.bm: Serangan ke atas lokasi tenaga Teluk terus menekan harga minyak dan kos subsidi bahan api Malaysia.
why.en: Attacks on Gulf energy sites keep oil prices and Malaysian fuel-subsidy costs under pressure.

summary.bm: IRGC mendakwa menyerang radar Patriot di dua pangkalan Bahrain dengan peluru berpandu dan dron, manakala Bahrain melaporkan kebakaran di tapak perindustrian awam tanpa kecederaan. AS mengekalkan sekatan, dan Menteri Luar Turkiye berkata rundingan Hormuz diteruskan walaupun buntu.
summary.en: The IRGC claimed missile and drone strikes on Patriot radars at two Bahrain bases, while Bahrain reported a fire at a civilian industrial site with no injuries. The US keeps its blockade, and Turkey's foreign minister says Hormuz talks continue despite the deadlock.

title.bm: Iran dakwa ia, bukan pasukan asing, mengawal Hormuz ketika serangan ke atas Bahrain dan Arab Saudi meningkat
title.en: Iran says it, not foreign forces, controls Hormuz as strikes on Bahrain and Saudi Arabia escalate

why.bm: Pertikaian kawalan Hormuz mengekalkan harga minyak dan kos penghantaran tidak menentu, yang menjejaskan harga bahan api dan import Malaysia.
why.en: Contested control of Hormuz keeps oil and shipping costs volatile, which feeds Malaysian fuel and import prices.

summary.bm: Trump berkata beliau mahu perjanjian kekal bagi menghalang Iran memiliki senjata nuklear dan langkah seterusnya mungkin hanya pada 2027. Beliau juga mendakwa Tehran mungkin membangunkan senjata kimia atau biologi, yang dinafikan Tehran.
summary.en: Trump says he wants a permanent deal to stop Iran getting a nuclear weapon and that the next move may not come until 2027. He also said Tehran may be working on chemical or biological weapons, which Tehran denies.

title.bm: Trump mahu perjanjian 'kekal' dengan Iran, beri amaran langkah seterusnya mungkin hanya pada 2027
title.en: Trump says he wants a 'permanent' Iran deal and warns the next move may not come until 2027

why.bm: Menandakan konflik tidak akan tamat segera, jadi risiko harga tenaga dan pasaran mungkin berpanjangan.
why.en: Signals no quick end to the standoff, so energy-price and market risk may last.

summary.bm: Media Iran berkata serangan itu membalas pencerobohan ruang udara Iran oleh AS; pertahanan udara Bahrain memintas beberapa serangan dan kebakaran melanda kompleks perindustrian awam tanpa kecederaan dilaporkan. IRGC mendakwa dua bateri Patriot dan satu radar dimusnahkan, tetapi Bahrain dan AS belum mengesahkannya, manakala lebih 14 kapal tangki Iran disiapkan di Pulau Kharg untuk menembusi sekatan AS. Bahrain memintas beberapa serangan; CENTCOM menafikan dakwaan Iran kononnya sebuah F-16 AS rosak.
summary.en: Iranian media say the strikes answer US incursions into Iranian airspace; Bahrain's air defences intercepted several attacks and a fire hit a civilian industrial compound with no injuries reported. The IRGC claims two Patriot batteries and a radar were hit, which neither Bahrain nor the US has confirmed, while more than 14 Iranian tankers are readied off Kharg Island to break the US blockade. Bahrain intercepted several attacks; CENTCOM denied an Iranian claim of damage to a US F-16.

title.bm: Iran lancar dua gelombang dron dan peluru berpandu ke empat pangkalan AS di Bahrain; sekurang-kurangnya tiga kapal tangki diserang berhampiran Hormuz
title.en: Iran fires two waves of drones and missiles at four US bases in Bahrain; at least three tankers hit near Hormuz

why.bm: Peningkatan ketegangan berhampiran laluan minyak Teluk boleh menggerakkan harga minyak, bahan api dan ringgit; Qatar sedang menjadi pengantara dan Trump mahu perjanjian 'kekal'.
why.en: Escalation near the Gulf's oil routes can move oil, fuel prices and the ringgit; Qatar is mediating and Trump says he wants a 'permanent' deal.

summary.bm: Reuters melaporkan lapan terbunuh — enam di Kyiv, dua di stesen kereta api Lviv — selepas Rusia menyerang jambatan, kemudahan air dan tenaga Kyiv. Zelensky berkata Rusia melancarkan lebih 400 dron dan 110+ peluru berpandu; tentera udara Ukraine berkata ia menembak jatuh 380 dron dan 79 peluru berpandu pelayaran.
summary.en: Reuters reports eight killed — six in Kyiv, two at a Lviv railway station — after Russia hit Kyiv bridges, water and energy sites. Zelensky said Russia launched over 400 drones and 110+ missiles; Ukraine's air force said it downed 380 drones and 79 cruise missiles.

title.bm: Rusia serang Ukraine lagi selepas Putin berikrar membalas; Kyiv dan Lviv terjejas
title.en: Russia pounds Ukraine again after Putin vowed retaliation; Kyiv and Lviv hit

why.bm: Peningkatan ketegangan susulan ikrar Putin untuk tindak balas 'menyakitkan' atas Jambatan Kerch dan menambah risiko tenaga Eropah.
why.en: Escalation follows Putin's pledge of a 'painful' response over the Kerch Bridge and deepens energy risk for Europe.

summary.bm: Surat berita melaporkan Anthropic menetapkan harga IPO $83 dan didagangkan sebagai ANT, dengan pemfailan menunjukkan perbelanjaan pengkomputeran sehingga $120.5 bilion dengan SpaceX hingga 2029. Ia juga memendekkan tempoh pendedahan kerentanan terkoordinasi daripada 90 kepada 30 hari mulai 1 Januari; angka berbeza sedikit antara surat berita.
summary.en: Newsletters report Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 and trades as ANT, and that its filing shows up to $120.5bn of compute spending with SpaceX through 2029. It will also shorten its coordinated vulnerability disclosure window from 90 to 30 days from 1 January; figures differ slightly between newsletters.

title.bm: Butiran IPO Anthropic: kira-kira $83 sesaham, tempoh pendedahan kerentanan 30 hari mulai Januari
title.en: Anthropic IPO details: about $83 a share, 30-day vulnerability disclosure window from January

why.bm: Tempoh pendedahan lebih pendek bermakna pasukan IT ada masa lebih singkat untuk menampal selepas kerentanan dilaporkan.
why.en: Shorter disclosure windows mean IT teams get less time to patch after a flaw is reported.

summary.bm: Levent Alpöge berkata hujah-hujah itu diformalkan tanpa andaian, dilaporkan dalam Lean. Bukti itu belum disahkan secara bebas. Pada 21 Nov komuniti Lean dan Mathlib menyatakan keyakinan penuh terhadap bukti Lean sekitar 17 juta baris itu, dan binaan semula bebas menghasilkan keputusan sama; Institut Clay masih menyenaraikan masalah itu sebagai terbuka.
summary.en: Levent Alpöge says arguments were formalised without assumptions, reportedly in Lean. The proof has not been independently verified. On 21 Nov the Lean and Mathlib communities said they had full confidence in the roughly 17-million-line Lean proof, and independent rebuilds reproduced it; the Clay Institute still lists the problem as open.

title.bm: Ahli matematik Anthropic dakwa beliau dan Claude menemui bukti hipotesis Riemann (belum disahkan)
title.en: Anthropic mathematician says he and Claude found a proof of the Riemann hypothesis (unverified)

why.bm: Anggap sebagai dakwaan belum disahkan sehingga disemak ahli matematik bebas.
why.en: Treat as an unverified claim until independent mathematicians check it.

summary.bm: ANT menetapkan harga 980 juta saham pada $83 dan mengumpul $81.3 bilion, ditutup $97.17 hari pertama, kemudian merosot Jumaat ketika Nasdaq jatuh 5.28%.
summary.en: ANT priced 980M shares at $83, raising $81.3bn, closed day one at $97.17, then slid on Friday as Nasdaq fell 5.28%.

title.bm: Saham Anthropic jatuh sekitar 9% pada hari kedua, ditutup sedikit di atas harga IPO $83
title.en: Anthropic shares fall about 9% on day two, closing just above the $83 IPO price

why.bm: Menunjukkan betapa rapuhnya penilaian AI dalam kejatuhan pasaran.
why.en: Shows how fragile AI valuations are in the sell-off.

summary.bm: Dompet ini dibina bersama American Express, Chase, Mastercard dan Visa. OpenAI turut memotong harga API GPT-6.2 Astra sebanyak 20% kepada $8 sejuta token input dan $40 sejuta token output.
summary.en: The wallet was built with American Express, Chase, Mastercard and Visa. OpenAI also cut GPT-6.2 Astra's API price 20% to $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens.

title.bm: OpenAI lancar ChatGPT Wallet supaya ejen AI boleh membayar tanpa melihat nombor kad
title.en: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet so AI agents can pay without seeing card numbers

why.bm: Pembayaran oleh ejen AI semakin hampir, jadi jangkakan corak penipuan baharu juga.
why.en: Agent-led payments are arriving, so expect new scam and fraud patterns too.

summary.bm: Gemini 4 Neon berharga AS$3 sejuta token input dan AS$15 sejuta token output, menurut rumusan berita AI.
summary.en: Gemini 4 Neon is priced at $3 per million input and $15 per million output tokens, per AI news roundups.

title.bm: Google lancar Gemini 4 Neon dengan konteks 1 juta token
title.en: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon with 1M-token context

why.bm: Pilihan konteks panjang lebih murah untuk pembangun dan perniagaan.
why.en: Cheaper long-context option for developers and businesses.

summary.bm: OpenAI melancarkan GPT-6.2 Astra dan Sol pada 17 Nov; surat berita melaporkan harga API Astra $8 sejuta token input dan $40 sejuta token output. Angka ini mengikut laporan surat berita, belum disemak pada laman OpenAI.
summary.en: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol on 17 Nov; newsletters report Astra API pricing of $8 per million input and $40 per million output tokens. Figures are as reported by a newsletter, not checked against OpenAI's page.

title.bm: OpenAI lancar GPT-6.2 Astra dan Sol, harga API Astra dipotong kira-kira 20%
title.en: OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, cutting Astra API prices about 20%

why.bm: Model termaju yang lebih murah mengurangkan kos pembangun dan perniagaan Malaysia yang membina atas API AI.
why.en: Cheaper frontier models lower costs for Malaysian developers and businesses building on AI APIs.

summary.bm: Blog pasaran Yahoo Finance melaporkan CrowdStrike bersetuju mengambil alih Zscaler bernilai AS$43.9 bilion. Tawaran itu menggabungkan platform keselamatan titik akhir dan awan; kelulusan pengawal selia masih diperlukan.
summary.en: Yahoo Finance's market blog reports CrowdStrike agreed to acquire Zscaler for $43.9 billion. The deal would combine endpoint and cloud-security platforms; regulatory approval is still needed.

title.bm: CrowdStrike dilaporkan beli Zscaler bernilai AS$43.9 bilion dalam tawaran keselamatan siber besar
title.en: CrowdStrike reported to buy Zscaler for $43.9bn in a major cybersecurity deal

why.bm: Penyatuan vendor keselamatan boleh mengubah lesen dan sokongan untuk pasukan IT dan rangkaian; pantau notis pelanggan.
why.en: Security-vendor consolidation can change licensing and support for enterprise and network teams; watch for customer notices.

summary.bm: Cisco Expressway CVE-2026-76466 (CVSS 9.8, kelayakan keras membawa akses root) dan Apache Roller CVE-2026-129448 (CVSS 9.8) disahkan dieksploitasi, bersama pintasan pengesahan VMware vCenter CVE-2026-123890. Agensi AS mesti menampal menjelang 23 Nov.
summary.en: Cisco Expressway CVE-2026-76466 (CVSS 9.8, hard-coded credentials leading to root) and Apache Roller CVE-2026-129448 (CVSS 9.8) are confirmed exploited, alongside the VMware vCenter bypass CVE-2026-123890. US agencies must patch by 23 Nov.

title.bm: CISA tambah kelemahan Cisco Expressway, Apache Roller dan VMware vCenter ke senarai dieksploitasi
title.en: CISA adds Cisco Expressway, Apache Roller and VMware vCenter flaws to exploited list

why.bm: Pasukan rangkaian: tampal Cisco Expressway dan vCenter sekarang.
why.en: Network teams: patch Cisco Expressway and vCenter now.

summary.bm: Pintasan pengesahan dalam Directory Service vCenter memberi penyerang jauh sesi pentadbir; Broadcom membaiki pada 19 Nov (VMSA-2026-0009) tanpa penyelesaian sementara. Google GTIG dan Mandiant berkata kumpulan disyaki China, Armory Castle (dahulu UNC5221), mengeksploitasinya sejak awal September.
summary.en: An authentication bypass in vCenter's Directory Service gives remote attackers an admin session; Broadcom fixed it on 19 Nov (VMSA-2026-0009) with no workarounds. Google GTIG and Mandiant say suspected China-nexus group Armory Castle (formerly UNC5221) exploited it from early September.

title.bm: Kelemahan sifar-hari VMware vCenter (CVE-2026-123890, CVSS 9.8) dieksploitasi kumpulan dikaitkan China sejak September
title.en: VMware vCenter zero-day (CVE-2026-123890, CVSS 9.8) exploited by China-linked group since September

why.bm: Tampal segera: 9.1.1.0200, 9.0.2.0200 atau 8.0 U3m; hubungi Broadcom untuk 7.0. Asingkan pengurusan vCenter daripada internet.
why.en: Patch now: 9.1.1.0200, 9.0.2.0200 or 8.0 U3m; contact Broadcom for 7.0. Isolate vCenter management from the internet.

summary.bm: CVE-2026-76466 (CVSS 9.8) membolehkan penyerang tanpa pengesahan menjalankan arahan sebagai root pada Expressway X14 dan lebih awal serta X15.5.3 dan lebih awal. Firma Rusia F6 melihat eksploitasi sebenar selepas PoC awam muncul; empat peranti ditembusi dan penyerang sampai ke sistem SMB, SQL Server, WinRM dan GitLab.
summary.en: CVE-2026-76466 (CVSS 9.8) lets an unauthenticated attacker run commands as root on Expressway X14 and earlier and X15.5.3 and earlier. A Russian firm, F6, saw in-the-wild exploitation after a public PoC appeared; four devices were breached and attackers reached SMB, SQL Server, WinRM and GitLab systems.

title.bm: Penyerang tembusi empat peranti Cisco Expressway dan bergerak ke rangkaian dalaman
title.en: Attackers breach four Cisco Expressway devices and move into internal networks

why.bm: Tampal/hijrah ke keluaran yang dibaiki (tampalan sejak 21 Okt), audit kemungkinan pencerobohan dan asingkan rangkaian.
why.en: Patch/migrate to a fixed release (patches out since 21 Oct), audit for compromise and segment the network.

summary.bm: F5 mendedahkan enam kelemahan kritikal BIG-IP pada 18 Nov yang boleh merosakkan TMM dan mungkin membenarkan pelaksanaan kod dengan konfigurasi iRules atau APM tertentu. Nasihat K000164058.
summary.en: F5 disclosed six critical BIG-IP flaws on 18 Nov that can crash TMM and may allow code execution with certain iRules or APM setups. Advisory K000164058.

title.bm: F5 BIG-IP: enam kelemahan kritikal (CVSS 9.8) didedahkan, hanya hotfix tersedia
title.en: F5 BIG-IP: six critical flaws (CVSS 9.8) disclosed, hotfix only

why.bm: Pentadbir rangkaian: semak versi BIG-IP anda berbanding F5 K000164058 dan guna hotfix.
why.en: Network admins: check your BIG-IP version against F5 K000164058 and apply the hotfix.

summary.bm: Apple menjawab pemfailan Epic berhubung dokumen komisen App Store dalam pertikaian mahkamah yang berterusan.
summary.en: Apple responded to Epic's filing on App Store commission documents in the ongoing court dispute.

title.bm: Apple balas Epic atas dakwaan menyembunyikan 122,000 dokumen
title.en: Apple fires back at Epic over claims it withheld 122,000 documents

why.bm: Kes ini boleh membentuk yuran dan peraturan App Store untuk pembangun dan pengguna.
why.en: The case could shape App Store fees and rules for developers and users.

summary.bm: TechCrunch melaporkan kerajaan UK dipaksa mendedahkan perintah rahsia yang menuntut akses kepada data pengguna Apple.
summary.en: TechCrunch reports the UK government has been forced to disclose a secret order demanding access to Apple user data.

title.bm: Kerajaan UK dipaksa dedah perintah rahsia pintu belakang Apple
title.en: UK government forced to disclose secret Apple backdoor order

why.bm: Ia menyentuh keselamatan data iCloud disulitkan untuk pengguna di seluruh dunia.
why.en: It bears on the security of encrypted iCloud data for users worldwide.

summary.bm: Notifikasi ancaman Apple 29 Okt dihantar kepada pengguna di 99 negara; menteri Thailand berkata amaran sahaja tidak membuktikan peranti dijejaskan dan tiada bukti kaitan dengan Pegasus. SecurityWeek turut menerangkan bagaimana Secure Exclaves Apple melindungi data kamera dan mikrofon.
summary.en: Apple's 29 Oct threat notifications went to users in 99 countries; Thailand's minister said alerts alone do not show a device was compromised and no evidence links it to Pegasus. SecurityWeek separately explained how Apple's Secure Exclaves protect camera and microphone data.

title.bm: Apple bertemu pegawai Thailand berhubung amaran perisian intip selepas notifikasi ancaman 29 Okt
title.en: Apple meets Thai officials over spyware alerts sent after its 29 Oct threat notifications

why.bm: Jika menerima amaran ancaman Apple, kemas kini iOS dan pertimbangkan Mod Lockdown.
why.en: If you receive an Apple threat alert, update iOS and consider Lockdown Mode.

summary.bm: Nasihat menyenaraikan kira-kira sembilan kelemahan dalam sembang kumpulan iMessage, pasangan Bluetooth dan AirPlay; Apple tidak menyatakan ada yang dieksploitasi.
summary.en: The advisory lists around nine vulnerabilities in iMessage group chat, Bluetooth pairing and AirPlay; Apple did not say any was exploited.

title.bm: Apple keluarkan pembaikan keselamatan iOS/macOS 27.2.1, serta iOS 26.7.3 dan 18.7.12 untuk peranti lama
title.en: Apple ships iOS/macOS 27.2.1 security fixes, plus iOS 26.7.3 and 18.7.12 for older devices

why.bm: Kemas kini melalui Settings > General > Software Update.
why.en: Update via Settings > General > Software Update.

summary.bm: Choi Won-Joon mengambil alih bahagian mudah alih Samsung buat kali pertama dalam beberapa tahun.
summary.en: Choi Won-Joon takes charge of Samsung's mobile division for the first time in years.

title.bm: Bahagian mudah alih Samsung dapat ketua baharu selepas pelancaran Galaxy Z Fold 8
title.en: Samsung's mobile division gets a new head after Galaxy Z Fold 8 launch

why.bm: Perubahan kepimpinan boleh mempengaruhi harga dan hala tuju produk Galaxy.
why.en: Leadership changes can steer Galaxy pricing and product direction.

summary.bm: Laman utama Carian Google mendapat bar sisi sejarah sembang Gemini.
summary.en: The Google Search homepage is getting a Gemini chat-history sidebar.

title.bm: Laman utama Google lancar reka bentuk baharu berfokuskan AI dengan sembang Gemini anda
title.en: Google homepage rolls out AI-focused redesign with your Gemini chats

why.bm: Mengubah cara pengguna harian mencapai AI melalui Carian.
why.en: Changes how everyday users reach AI from Search.

summary.bm: Android Police berkata sesetengah pengguna Pixel 11 Pro dan Pro XL melihat skrin hitam atau ralat pada aplikasi kamera, berdasarkan hantaran pengguna dan bukan kerosakan meluas yang disahkan. Google belum mengeluarkan pembaikan rasmi; mematikan telefon 1–2 minit membantu sekurang-kurangnya seorang pengguna.
summary.en: Android Police says some Pixel 11 Pro and Pro XL users see a black screen or error in the camera app, based on user posts rather than a confirmed widespread fault. Google has not issued an official fix; powering off for 1–2 minutes helped at least one user.

title.bm: Pemilik Pixel lapor pepijat kamera dan lain-lain selepas kemas kini Android 17 November
title.en: Pixel owners report camera and other bugs after the Android 17 November update

why.bm: Jika terjejas, mulakan semula dan tunggu pembaikan Google.
why.en: If affected, restart and watch for Google's fix before rolling back.

summary.bm: Tajuk berita menyebut ia membaiki hampir 180 kelemahan (tajuk sahaja; halaman tidak dibuka).
summary.en: Headlines say it fixes almost 180 vulnerabilities (headline only; page not opened).

title.bm: Samsung lancar tampalan keselamatan November untuk Galaxy S26 dan Z Fold 8
title.en: Samsung rolls out November security patch to Galaxy S26 and Z Fold 8

why.bm: Pasang kemas kini pada telefon Galaxy anda.
why.en: Install the update on your Galaxy phone.

summary.bm: Nvidia berkata Huang kembali sebagai CEO serta-merta, 11 hari selepas beliau meletak jawatan pada 12 Nov; lembaga berkata siasatan bebasnya akan diteruskan hingga selesai dan sebuah jawatankuasa keselamatan negara dan kawalan eksport ditubuhkan. Saham melonjak mendadak sebelum dan semasa pasaran dibuka.
summary.en: Nvidia said Huang returns as CEO effective immediately, 11 days after he resigned on 12 Nov; the board says its independent investigation will proceed to conclusion and a national security and export-control committee has been set up. Shares jumped sharply premarket and at the open.

title.bm: Nvidia melantik semula Jensen Huang sebagai CEO; saham melonjak, siasatan diteruskan
title.en: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO; shares leap and the investigation continues

why.bm: Nvidia menjadi tunggak rantaian cip AI yang bergantung kepada sektor pusat data dan semikonduktor Malaysia.
why.en: Nvidia anchors the AI chip chain that Malaysia's data-centre and semiconductor sectors rely on.

summary.bm: Laporan Reuters mengenai siasatan SEC menjejaskan saham selepas CEO Jensen Huang meletak jawatan pada 12 Nov; Peguam Negara California mengeluarkan sapina 19 Nov dan Huang dijadual hadir di jawatankuasa Dewan pada 1–2 Dis.
summary.en: A Reuters report of an SEC inquiry hit the shares after CEO Jensen Huang resigned on 12 Nov; California's attorney general subpoenaed on 19 Nov and Huang is due before House committees on 1–2 Dec.

title.bm: Nvidia jatuh 13% susulan laporan siasatan perakaunan SEC
title.en: Nvidia drops 13% on report of SEC accounting inquiry

why.bm: Nvidia menggerakkan rantaian AI dan semikonduktor yang menjadi tunggak Malaysia.
why.en: Nvidia drives the AI and semiconductor chain that Malaysia depends on.

summary.bm: Nvidia berhenti menghantar cip kelas H200 ke China walaupun diluluskan AS; CEO sementara Colette Kress berkata tiada penghantaran berlesen lagi dirancang. Moody's menurunkan tinjauan kepada stabil kerana tiada pelan penggantian.
summary.en: Nvidia stopped shipping H200-class chips to China despite US approval, with interim CEO Colette Kress saying no further licensed shipments are planned. Moody's cut its outlook to stable citing no succession plan.

title.bm: Nvidia henti penghantaran H200 ke China; Jensen Huang telah keluar; Moody's turunkan tinjauan
title.en: Nvidia halts China H200 shipments; Jensen Huang has left; Moody's cuts outlook

why.bm: Gegaran bagi rantaian bekalan cip AI, termasuk pusat data Malaysia.
why.en: A shake-up for the AI chip supply chain, including Malaysian data centres.

summary.bm: The Star melaporkan Washington bertindak menyekat akses jauh kepada cip AI termaju melalui negara ketiga. Nvidia juga menolak kepulangan Jensen Huang ketika kempen menuntut beliau kembali membesar, menjelang laporan pendapatan.
summary.en: The Star reports Washington is moving to restrict remote access to advanced AI chips through third countries. Nvidia also ruled out a comeback by Jensen Huang as a campaign for his return grows, ahead of its earnings.

title.bm: AS bertindak menyekat akses jauh kepada cip AI termaju melalui negara ketiga
title.en: US moves to restrict remote access to advanced AI chips via third countries

why.bm: Boleh menjejaskan akses awan dan pusat data untuk beban kerja AI yang dihoskan di Malaysia.
why.en: Could affect cloud and data centre access for Malaysia-hosted AI workloads.

summary.bm: Malay Mail melaporkan projek kabel dasar laut bernilai RM2.7 bilion itu diluluskan. Ia akan menghubungkan Semenanjung Malaysia dengan Sabah dan Sarawak.
summary.en: Malay Mail reports the RM2.7 billion submarine cable project has been approved. It would link Peninsular Malaysia with Sabah and Sarawak.

title.bm: TM Tech dapat lampu hijau projek kabel dasar laut RM2.7b menghubungkan Semenanjung, Sabah dan Sarawak
title.en: TM Tech gets green light for RM2.7b submarine cable linking Peninsular Malaysia, Sabah and Sarawak

why.bm: Sambungan lebih baik untuk Malaysia Timur serta pertumbuhan pusat data dan digital.
why.en: Better connectivity for East Malaysia and for data-centre and digital growth.

title.en: CISA deadline: Cisco BroadWorks and Openwave flaws

note.bm: Pakej sekatan Rusia ke-22 dan pembiayaan Ukraine dijangka.
note.en: 22nd Russia sanctions package and Ukraine funding expected.

title.en: Special European Council (26-27 Nov)

title.en: Nvidia's Huang due before US House committees (1–2 Dec)
